inputs.text:
A focused dance athlete in neutral gray practice wear (fitted top + joggers) performing a sharp hip-hop isolation sequence against a seamless dark gray studio backdrop. Soft, even key lighting from 45-degree left (no harsh shadows), slight fill from right.

[0:00-0:05]
- Chest isolation: Sharp, repeated pops (inhale/exhale-driven), shoulders locked, pelvis stable.
- Camera: Steady medium shot (knees to top of head), slightly low angle to emphasize torso movement.

[0:05-0:10]
- Shoulder isolation: Alternating forward rolls (scapular glide), spine vertical, hips square.
- Camera: Slow push-in to medium-close up (waist to shoulders) to highlight scapular movement.

[0:10-0:15]
- Waist isolation: Controlled lateral slides (left/right), ribcage isolated, pelvis & shoulders stable.
- Camera: Static wide shot (full body) to show clean lateral line — no shoulder/hip drift.

[0:15-0:20]
- Combo phrase: Chest pop (2x) -> shoulder roll (left/right) -> waist slide (left/right) -> sharp head isolations (left/right/x2), all in 8-count rhythm.
- Camera: Steady medium shot, slight upward tilt to engage eye line with movement.
- Final frame: Dancer holds neutral pose, breath visible, confident but not performative.

Technical notes:
- Movement quality: Sharp initiations, clean stops, zero excess motion (precision > speed).
- Attire: Non-distracting, fitted to show joint alignment (no logos/text).
- Lighting: Even, shadow-minimized to highlight muscle engagement.
- Style: Documentary/raw — no filters, no slow-mo (preserves temporal accuracy for technique viewing).
